review_design: retrospective deterministic source-publication audit; not preregistered, not an independent fact-check, and not an independent reproduction

records.public_claim_text: However, in terms of rates, between 2000 and 2016 the global rates of total deaths attributable to exposure to occupational risk factors decreased from 39.9 to 34.3 deaths per 100 000 working age population; this was a decrease of 5.7 deaths per 100 000 working-age population or by 14.2%.

records.public_claim_text: Similarly, the global rates of total DALYs attributable to exposure to occupational risk factors decreased from 1878.4 to 1635.9 DALYs per 100 000 working-age population; this was a decrease of 242.5 DALYs per 100 000 working-age population or 12.9%.
